name: dsh-restart-center
description: Restart control for the Desktop window chrome, sitting beside the built-in Application/Edit menus: two confirm dialogs, a session-running warning, and an install/queue notice that stops you from restarting in the middle of a plugin installation.

meta.title: 重启中心
meta.description: 标题栏「应用 / 编辑」同级放一个重启按钮：二次确认弹窗，有会话在跑会警告，有插件在装或排队会提示；确认后重启整个桌面应用。
